title: [SEP-13] Blob upload has no defined admission or quota attribution
description: Review finding SEP-13: Blob upload has no defined admission or quota attribution (lens SEP). Location: spec/11-transport.md:271, 279; spec/10-relays.md:537, 566-578. Fix: As proposed. 11:279 applies the access proof to envelopes only, and §10.4.4 defines no write-side rule for blobs. Require an `accessSig` over the blob CID for a registered `channelToken` on upload, as with pin instructions, so quota is charged to the agreement through the chain. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/10-relays.md §10.4.4 Upload admission (Agora-Storage-Auth signed with registered admission key, charged to agreement); §10.5.4 same registrations admit blob uploads
